name: postman-agent-quality-gate
description: Works with the postman-agent-quality-gate CI gate: a gate-verdict agent that reads the CI result and writes a fixes brief, a gate-loop skill for the fix loop, and a live pane showing the gate for every branch.

workflow.title: Gate workflow name
workflow.description: Name of the GitHub Actions workflow that runs the gate in your repository.

resultsDir.title: Gate results directory
resultsDir.description: Directory the gate runner writes to; CI reports are cached under <dir>/ci/. Add it to .gitignore.
